product_metadata.title: Zenna Home Waterproof Fabric Shower Curtain or Liner, 70 in. x 72 in, Beige
features: WATERPROOF SHOWER CURTAIN OR LINER: Guaranteed 100% waterproof for your bathroom
THE BEST OF FABRIC AND VINYL: With the function and protection of vinyl and the look and feel of fabric
SPECIAL FEATURES: Includes a weighted magnetic hem and rustproof metal grommets at top
EASY TO KEEP CLEAN AND LOOKING NEW: Machine washable
MEASURES: 70 in. x 72 in. to fit in any standard shower or tub space
USE ALONE OR WITH A DECORATIVE CURTAIN: Your choice of using this on its own, or adding a curtain and using as a protective liner
description: Protect your bathroom floor and keep water inside the shower with the Zenna Home 100% Waterproof Fabric Shower Curtain or Liner. The waterproof fabric creates a protective barrier for your shower curtain to prevent water from getting through. Featuring the soft, comfortable feel of fabric with the function of a vinyl shower liner, this polyester shower liner is sure to add an upscale look and feel to your bathroom decor. Use on its own or with a decorative curtain.
